kjv: Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written
note: TR adds "hypage opiso mou satana" from Matt 16:23 (cf. Matt 4:10); absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, D, L, W.

kjv: he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted
note: TR adds "iasasthai tous syntetrimmenous ten kardian" from LXX Isa 61:1; absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, D, L, W.

kjv: but by every word of God
note: TR adds "all' epi panti rhemati theou" from Matt 4:4; absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, L, W.

kjv: he preached in the synagogues of Galilee
mine: he was preaching in the synagogues of Judea
note: TR "Galilaias" corrects the harder "Ioudaias" (Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, C, L), which Luke uses for the whole Jewish land.
